issues.detail: The brief exchange at u1834–u1835 calls the earlier hawk survey yesterday, although the enacted two-night sequence places the current scouting on May 13. Evidence: The morning of May 12 is played at u0889–u1580, followed by departure, an actual overnight camp at u1635–u1652, and a second dawn at u1653. No hawk survey is enacted on May 12.

resolution.reason: Retain the literal relative-day wording in the transcript, but date current play from the two explicit overnight sequences (u0815–u0889 and u1635–u1655). The isolated yesterday reference describes an earlier observation and does not erase the played travel day; the inferred May 11–13 span matches YAML without any date edit.

transitions.label: Session start
transitions.evidence: The session YAML anchors May 11. The opening recap ends at u0021–u0024 with dusk approaching; u0030 places the temple approach about 30–40 minutes before sunset. Earlier events in the recap do not advance or rewind the date of current play.

transitions.label: Sunlight leaves the temple windows
transitions.evidence: u0706–u0708 say the sun has dropped below the window and the temple is in twilight; u0767–u0784 describe the sunset afterglow as the party returns to camp. Calendar date inherited from the opening anchor.

transitions.label: First overnight rest
transitions.evidence: u0813–u0822 establish the rest and watches; u0829–u0842 organize the first, middle-night, and pre-dawn watches. This is the first actual overnight rest, not the short rest considered and rejected near the temple entrance.

transitions.label: Middle-night watch change
transitions.evidence: u0838 mentions 2 a.m., u0841 assigns the middle-night watch, and u0858–u0885 enact the handoffs from Delwath to Seeker and then Wellby. These watches carry the rest into May 12; exact handoff times are not fixed.

transitions.label: Dawn at the monastery camp
transitions.evidence: u0889–u0895 explicitly say dawn comes, everyone wakes, and the party eats breakfast. Date is inferred from the first overnight sequence.
transitions.sourceText: So as dawn comes and everybody wakes.

transitions.label: Wellby searches the monastery
transitions.evidence: u1164–u1165 explicitly place the search in early morning and say reaching the monastery takes about twenty minutes. The preceding planning has not advanced to another day.
transitions.sourceText: So you set out in the early morning.

transitions.label: Reaching the end of the cliffs
transitions.evidence: u1581–u1598 enact the southern ride, and u1593 states about 3 p.m. when the cliffs fall away and the party turns west. Same day as the morning patrol alarm.

transitions.label: Forced march ends in camp
transitions.evidence: u1621 describes about an extra hour of travel; u1629–u1637 establish camp and u1646 confirms that they rode past sunset into twilight. Kenzo and Seeker are exhausted.

transitions.evidence: u1648–u1652 describe Seeker’s middle-night watch and explicitly mention 3 a.m. before Wellby’s watch. The second overnight rest therefore reaches May 13.

transitions.evidence: u1681–u1689 describe the northward ride and explicitly give nine or nine-thirty on reaching the road.
